description: Sample ecosystem.yml-derived product list for the product-first host step (ADR-M3-005, S5). Config-driven -- N products, not a hardcoded Claude/Codex/Both toggle. Pre-checked entries reflect what a given ecosystem.yml already grants; narrow-not-widen means the wizard may only narrow this pre-checked set, never add a product the ecosystem doesn't already grant.
notes: ambiguous:true means more than one product is available, so Q1 is actually asked (0-question path only applies when the ecosystem grants exactly one product). A single-product variant (ambiguous:false, one entry) is left as an exercise for Stream-A's unit tests rather than duplicated here.
